svg.title: The durable gate, layer by layer: its steps outlive the worker that started them
svg.desc: Five layers, top to bottom. laug gate run -workflow starts workflow Gate on the orchestrator's dev server, which keeps Gate's history: the order, every answer, the timers. This checkout's worker runs Gate's activities, each gate/step.sh in a session of its own that writes its .pid first and its .done last. The steps lease cells from laug pool serve and run loads, faults and the judge on them. The worker's box is dashed, and the two lines under the layers say why: kill the worker and the step's session runs on, and the next worker adopts it by its .pid record, the process, its start time and its boot id, when the record passes; without -workflow, gate/run.sh runs every step in one process. Sources: cmd/laug/doc.go, docs/img/src/gate-layers.txt, gate/lib.sh, internal/orchestrator/gate.go, internal/orchestrator/steps.go.
svg.text: The durable gate, layer by layer: its steps outlive the worker that started them
laug gate run <tag> -workflow: history on the dev server, each step in its own session, cells from the pool

g.aria-label: laug gate run <tag> -workflow, runs gate/step.sh check, then starts workflow Gate as gate-<gate id>
g.text: runs gate/step.sh check, then starts workflow Gate as gate-<gate id>

g.aria-label: the dev server, 127.0.0.1:7400, Gate's history in orchestrator/run/dev.db: the order, every answer, the timers
g.text: Gate's history in orchestrator/run/dev.db: the order, every answer, the timers

g.aria-label: laug orchestrator worker, runs Step and AwaitItem, heartbeats every 2 s, replays every open Gate before it polls
g.text: runs Step and AwaitItem, heartbeats every 2 s, replays every open Gate before it polls

g.aria-label: gate/step.sh <verb> <dir> [key], in a session of its own, writes .steps/<name>.pid first and .done last; a second copy of the step refuses
g.text: gate/step.sh <verb> <dir> [key], in a session of its own
writes .steps/<name>.pid first and .done last; a second copy of the step refuses

g.aria-label: gate/lib.sh, leases cells from laug pool serve, 127.0.0.1:7700; runs the loads, the faults and the judge
g.text: leases cells from laug pool serve, 127.0.0.1:7700; runs the loads, the faults and the judge

svg.text: Kill the worker: the step's session runs on. The next worker adopts it by its .pid record, the process, its
start time and its boot id, and answers when its .done comes; a record that fails the check is a lost step.
Without -workflow, laug gate run runs gate/run.sh: every step in that one process, its driver run.sh.
